title: Refactor Compose TypeScript Object Model
description: Rewrite the Compose TypeScript implementation from mostly functional style to stateful object-oriented classes and methods. Remove floating functions in the covered TypeScript surface, add lazy cached granular properties such as piece.flatPlane() and piece.flatCenter(), replace guid-styled internal references with object pointers and serialize guids only at serialization boundaries, keep parent pointers from design/type/piece to kit or design, extend existing tests only, and verify tests pass.
